label: Artemis II Mission Status
delta: Day 45 post-splashdown: IFT-13 FCC window opens May 29 (Ship 40 + Booster 20, V3) — modified suborbital profile expected after Booster 19 loss. FAA IFT-12 assessment ongoing; orbital propellant transfer demo slips past June 2026. NASA Moon Base briefing May 26.
deltaNote: Day 45: Artemis II crew at JSC Houston. IFT-13 FCC Special Temporary Authority window: May 29 – Nov 29, 2026 (Ship 40 + Booster 20, V3 architecture, OLP-2, Starbase). Following Booster 19's boostback failure on IFT-12 (May 22), IFT-13 expected to fly a modified suborbital profile to re-validate boostback and landing sequences before orbital flight; FAA IFT-12 mishap assessment (target June 2026) must be resolved before IFT-13 license issues — earliest IFT-13 Q3 2026. Orbital propellant transfer demo (NASA HLS prerequisite: two Starships dock in LEO, transfer cryogenic propellant) has slipped from June 2026 to Q3-Q4 2026 minimum. Motley Fool (May 24): Rocket Lab may demo orbital fueling before SpaceX. NASA: Matt Anderson sworn in as 16th Deputy Administrator (May 21); agencywide realignment to accelerate mission delivery (May 22); Moon Base strategy news conference May 26 at 2 PM EDT. Artemis III spacer confirmed; MSFC fabricating spacer barrel and rings for 2027 LEO test. ICPS reserved for Artemis IV (2028 crewed landing).
